title: Private upgrade failure: Helm/operator timeouts & config-drift left during on-prem upgrades; hotfix track
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Summary:
Several on-prem / VPC customers reported failed platform upgrades when applying the private deployment Helm chart or when the Private Operator attempted an automated rollout. Symptoms include: Helm upgrade hooks timing out, operator CR reconciliation stuck in Pending/CrashLoop, partial resource updates (some Deployments upgraded while StatefulSets remained on older images), and subsequent drift between the control-plane desired state and node-level manifests.

Customers affected: customer-alpha (air-gapped), customer-beta (regulated EU), customer-gamma (bare-metal), multiple enterprise pilots. Support tickets: SUP-5879, SUP-5902, SUP-5917.

Repro steps observed in support triage:
- Apply chart (private-control-plane v1.18 -> v1.19) with default values + customer customizations.
- Helm waits on post-upgrade hook that performs node drainage and PVC reattachments. Hooks fail with timeout after 10m; operator continues trying to reconcile resources.
- Operator creates new ReplicaSet/StatefulSet but pods never pass readiness because preStop hooks hang on older container runtime signaling, leaving finalizers unresolved.
- On some clusters, imagePull backoff occurs due to restricted egress to registry causing operator level timeouts.
- Net effect: partially applied upgrades and config drift.

Investigation / Root cause analysis (current findings):
1) Helm hook + operator race: The Helm chart includes a migration Job and a pre-upgrade hook that expects nodes to drain quickly; however, when operator-triggered rolling upgrades are also in flight, operator reconciler re-applies resources leading to conflicting lifecycle signals.
2) Hook timeouts are conservative and do not account for on-prem runtime variability (containerd vs dockerd) and slower pod termination on bare-metal. Hooks default to 10m which is insufficient in some clusters.
3) Operator CRD reconciliation backoff interacts poorly with Helm 3.9 behavior around CR creation/update ordering; CRs sometimes arrive before CRDs are fully accepted on older kube versions (1.22, 1.23), producing partial state.
4) Image registry reachability: air-gapped customers without a mirror registry experience imagePull timeouts which propagate into helm/operator upgrade failures and lengthened release windows.
5) No robust config-drift detection after failed upgrades: the control plane lacks a standalone verification pass that compares chart-templated manifests vs applied cluster objects and raises a clear "drift" alert for SRE.

Mitigations applied so far (hotfix actions):
- Emergency patch (PR #1203) released to CI for hotfix build private-2026.03.2-hotfix, bumping Helm hook timeout to 30m for the migration job and adding exponential backoff/retry around node drain. (Deployed to canary customers customer-gamma and internal staging.)
- Operator reconciler updated to detect in-progress Helm hook annotations and avoid conflicting updates (PR #1207).
- Added additional logging and a `drift-check` Job that runs post-upgrade to snapshot resource diffs and uploads to a private S3 bucket for SRE analysis (confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PRIV/Upgrade+Drift+Playbook).
- Support playbook updated with step-by-step rollback and manual reconciliation commands (drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/priv-upgrade-playbooks).

Remaining work / action items (this ticket):
- (Diego) Finalize the operator change to gate reconciliation on helm-release annotations and add unit + e2e tests for the timing window (blocker: ENG-7398 covers e2e infra).
- (Asha) Wire the drift-check Job results into Console alerts (work with Console infra team, dependency: ENG-7405).
- (Infra) Expand our upgrade acceptance matrix to include kube versions 1.21-1.25 on bare-metal and containerd variants. Add mirror registry guidance and a validation step to detect missing mirrors pre-upgrade.
- Backport hotfix to 1.17 and 1.18 support branches for customers running older control planes.
- Coordinate scheduled hotfix rollout with affected customers and SRE on-call.

Acceptance criteria (for this ticket to be Done):
- Hotfix release private-2026.03.2-hotfix validated in staging and two on-prem canaries with different runtimes (customer-gamma, internal-canary).
- Drift-check job runs post-upgrade and produces deterministic JSON diff artifacts retained for 30 days.
- Operator reconciliation change prevents race with Helm hooks in reproducible test harness cases.
- Updated support playbook and runbook confirmed by SRE and Solutions Eng.

Risks / trade-offs:
- Increasing hook timeout delays upgrades for all customers; mitigation: only increase for Private installs via values.yaml and keep hosted defaults unchanged.
- Introducing drift-check exposes sensitive cluster manifests; ensure artifacts are encrypted and access-limited.

Related artifacts and links:

- Support tickets: SUP-5879, SUP-5902, SUP-5917
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PRIV/Upgrade+Drift+Playbook
